headline: Where we are and where we serve
lead: A water system is only as available as the nearest technician and the nearest spare. Before you shortlist us, check your site against the table below: for each region it gives the severity 1 on-site response time on a service plan, where the technician comes from, where the parts are stocked, how pressure equipment is registered under CSA B51, which provincial engineering licence covers the design, and the language service is given in. Design, fabrication and the factory acceptance test (FAT) happen in [shop location, city and province], and you can book a visit to the shop and test bay on this page. Any figure in square brackets is not yet published; we state it once it is verified.

blocks.h: How to read the coverage table
body: Response times are the plan figures from the service plans page and use the same four severities as the service request form. Severity 1 is production stopped or water out of specification at a point of use. The clock starts when you log the request by phone or form and stops when [a technician is on site / the stated event, to be defined]. Response times apply inside [service coverage area]. For a site outside it, we write a travel response time into the plan schedule before you sign, so nobody discovers the distance during a fault.

The regions follow where pharmaceutical manufacturing sits. The pharmaceutical industry profile from Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada places most of it in the Toronto, Montreal and Vancouver metropolitan areas, with biotechnology, medical device and contract manufacturing (CDMO) sites spread more widely. If your centre is not named, the row for your province still applies: send the site address and we state the response time for that address in writing.

Two columns are about the design, not the visit. Under CSA B51, pressure-retaining stills, pure steam generators and pressure-rated tanks need a Canadian registration number (CRN) from the authority in the province of installation, and a design registered in one province is registered again for another. Engineering is licensed by province too: drawings and calculations for your site are sealed by an engineer licensed where the site is, P.Eng. or, in Quebec, ing. Check both before award; the standards page explains the CRN route in full.

blocks.h: Book a shop or test bay visit
blocks.intro: Most buyers visit once before award and again for the FAT. Tell us why you are coming and who is in the group, and we plan the day around it: a supplier audit gets the quality records out, a FAT witness gets the approved protocol and a calibrated test bay. Visits are on working days at [shop location, city and province].
blocks.note: We reply with a proposed date and an agenda within [visit booking reply time, working days]. Visitors sign [visitor confidentiality and safety terms] on arrival. We use your details for this visit only. [Privacy notice link; PIPEDA, Quebec Law 25]

items.q: Our site is not in a named centre. Are we covered?
items.a: The row for your province applies. Send the site address and we state the on-site response time, the stocking point and the base the technician comes from, in writing, before you sign a plan.

items.q: What happens if our site is outside your service area?
items.a: We agree a travel response time in the plan schedule before you sign, and recommend a critical spares kit held on your site, so a fault waits for a technician and not for a part. [Confirm whether partners cover remote regions.]

items.q: Who is the technician: your employee or a subcontractor?
items.a: [State whether all technicians are Aquemi employees, or where partners are used, under whose procedures they work and who signs the service report.]

items.q: Do you service systems another builder supplied?
items.a: [Confirm any-builder service: equipment types and makes covered.] The service request form takes the make and model; you do not need an Aquemi serial number.

items.q: Will our system get a CRN in our province?
items.a: Pressure-retaining equipment is registered under CSA B51 with the authority in the province of installation, and registration sits in the project schedule from the start. [State Aquemi's route: ASME certificate of authorization or certified vessel fabricator, and provinces registered to date.]

items.q: Can the design be sealed by an engineer licensed in our province?
items.a: [State the provinces where Aquemi engineers hold a licence (P.Eng. or ing.) and where the firm holds a permit or certificate of authorization.] Where we are not licensed, [state the route, e.g. a licensed engineer of record engaged for the project].

[Confirm which people work in French, which documents are offered in French and how translations are reviewed.] For a system installed in Quebec, ask your legal team which documents the Charter of the French language requires in French.

items.q: Can we witness the FAT without travelling?
items.a: Yes: remotely over [remote witness platform], in person, or both. Checks that need a person, such as noise, heat or the inside of a panel, are agreed in the protocol; the FAT and SAT page lists them.

items.q: Do you ship to sites in the United States?
items.a: [State whether Aquemi delivers to US sites.] The table above lists what changes: ASME and National Board registration in place of a CRN, UL 508A panels, customs under the Incoterms rule in the contract, and how service reaches the site.

cta.h: Get the coverage for your site in writing
cta.body: Send your site address with your proposal or service plan request. We reply with the on-site response time, the base and stocking point that serve you, the CRN route and the licensed engineer for your province.
